# Baking day

Evening: feed the starter and mix the dough. Morning: shape the loaf, let it rest in the basket, preheat the oven with the pot inside to 250 degrees. Bake covered for twenty minutes, then uncovered until the crust is dark brown. Let the loaf cool for an hour before cutting it.

Needs a lively [[Baking/sourdough-starter]].
